user.title: Setup PV Energy Management+
user.description: PV management for fixed-price tariffs. Calculates amortization, energy benchmark and optionally compares with spot prices.

data_description.name: Name for this PV system
data_description.pv_production_entity: Sensor measuring total PV production in kWh
data_description.grid_export_entity: Sensor for grid export in kWh (for earnings calculation)
data_description.grid_import_entity: Sensor for grid import in kWh (for spot comparison)
data_description.consumption_entity: Sensor for total household consumption in kWh
data_description.fixed_price: Net energy price from provider (e.g., 12.55 ct/kWh). Found on bill under 'Energy charges'.
data_description.grid_fee: Per kWh — Grid usage + grid loss fee from your bill (e.g. 6.78 ct/kWh). Leave at 0 to use markup factor instead.
data_description.taxes_levies: Per kWh — Electricity tax + renewable levies from your bill (e.g. 2.43 ct/kWh).
data_description.vat_percent: VAT on the total sum (AT: 20%, DE: 19%). Found at the bottom of your bill.
data_description.markup_factor: Flat alternative: Gross = Net × Factor (e.g. 2.0 turns 10ct into 20ct). Only used when grid fee and taxes are 0.
data_description.electricity_price_entity: Optional: Sensor for dynamic electricity price (overrides static energy price)
data_description.feed_in_tariff_unit: Choose if feed-in tariff is in Euro or Cent per kWh
data_description.installation_cost: Total cost of PV system including installation
data_description.installation_date: Date of installation for accurate statistics

abort.already_configured: This PV system has already been configured

sensors.title: Energy Sensors
sensors.description: Configure sensors for energy tracking and spot comparison.

data_description.pv_production_entity: Total kWh counter of PV system
data_description.grid_export_entity: Total kWh counter for grid export
data_description.grid_import_entity: Total kWh counter for grid import
data_description.consumption_entity: Total kWh counter for household consumption

prices.title: Electricity Prices & Amortization
prices.description: Enter the values from your electricity bill. Alternatively: Just use the markup factor at the bottom.

data_description.fixed_price: Static net energy price. Only used when NO sensor is selected.
data_description.grid_fee: Per kWh — Grid usage + grid loss fee (from bill). Gross = (Energy + Grid Fee + Taxes) × (1 + VAT%)
data_description.taxes_levies: Per kWh — Electricity tax + renewable levies (from bill).
data_description.vat_percent: VAT on the total sum (AT: 20%, DE: 19%).
data_description.markup_factor: Only when grid fee + taxes are 0! Gross = Net × Factor (e.g. 2.0 turns 10ct into 20ct).
data_description.electricity_price_entity: Sensor or input_number for current electricity price (e.g. dynamic tariff or manual value). Overrides the static value above. Unit (ct/EUR) auto-detected.
data_description.feed_in_tariff_unit: Unit for the static fallback value below
data_description.feed_in_tariff: Static feed-in tariff. Only used when NO sensor is selected.
data_description.feed_in_tariff_entity: Sensor or input_number for current feed-in tariff (e.g. market price). Overrides the static value above. Unit (ct/EUR) auto-detected.
data_description.installation_cost: Total cost of PV system (for amortization calculation)

offsets.title: Historical Data
offsets.description: Only needed if your PV system was running BEFORE this integration. Leave at 0 for new installations.

data_description.savings_offset: How much has the PV system already 'earned back'? E.g. from previous tracking or your own calculation. Savings are calculated at the current electricity price.
data_description.energy_offset_self_consumption: PV energy you consumed yourself before this integration started. Find in Energy Dashboard (self consumption = PV production minus export).
data_description.energy_offset_export: PV energy exported to the grid before this integration started. Find on your export meter or Energy Dashboard.

quota.title: Electricity Quota
quota.description: Fixed-price tariff with yearly kWh quota. Shows if you're within budget.

data.quota_start_meter: Grid import meter at start date (optional)

data_description.quota_yearly_kwh: Your yearly quota in kWh (e.g., 4000 kWh)
data_description.quota_start_date: Start of tariff period (read from invoice, doesn't have to be Jan 1)
data_description.quota_start_meter: Read from invoice or sensor history. Leave at 0 to auto-capture on start date.
data_description.quota_monthly_rate: Optional: Monthly payment in EUR (display only)

data_description.battery_soc_entity: Sensor for battery state of charge in percent (e.g. sensor.battery_state_of_charge)
data_description.battery_charge_entity: Sensor for total battery charge in kWh (e.g. sensor.total_battery_charge)
data_description.battery_discharge_entity: Sensor for total battery discharge in kWh (e.g. sensor.total_battery_discharge)
data_description.battery_capacity: Usable capacity of battery storage in kWh

benchmark.title: Energy Benchmark
benchmark.description: Compare your consumption with the average for your country.

data_description.benchmark_heatpump: When active, heat pump consumption is benchmarked separately
data_description.benchmark_heatpump_entity: Total kWh counter of heat pump (optional, for fair comparison)

pv_strings.title: PV Strings
pv_strings.description: Configure up to 4 PV strings for comparison. Only strings with name AND sensor will be shown.

data_description.pv_string_1_kwp: Installed nameplate capacity in kWp (optional, for specific yield + performance ratio)

reset.title: Reset Data
reset.description: Select which tracking data to reset. This cannot be undone!
